title: Sit Down. Order The Whole Menu.
hero_alt: Two bowls of nasi goreng topped with a fried egg, shot from above on a wooden table
body: Full table service and the whole menu, from wild-caught fish of the day to Bali and poke bowls, Balinese chicken satay and Nasi Goreng, for when you want to stay a while.
We're fully licensed for beer and wine, and gluten-free options are available across the menu.
